name: kitty

1.how: kitten @ --to unix:/tmp/kitty ls | send-text | get-text | launch | focus-window | set-colors (needs allow_remote_control yes and listen_on unix:/tmp/kitty)
1.notes: Complete remote control: read any pane's text, type into it, open new windows and tabs. Better than tmux for kitty users.

quirks: Remote control is off by default; MausOS Phase 1 enables it with a listen socket per session.
